question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**considering**" is typically used to show that some factors are being taken into account. (ध्यान में रखते हुए)
 
• In the context of the passage**, "considering"** correctly indicates that the heavy expenditure is a significant factor for why the results are not encouraging.
 
• The other options: "implying," "setting," and "manipulating" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** They were installed on an experimental basis and the results were not encouraging considering__ the heavy expenditure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Implying (संकेत करते हुए)**: suggesting the truth or existence of something not expressly stated.
 
• **Setting (स्थापित करते हुए)**: placing or setting something in a particular position.
 
• **Manipulating (हेरफेर करते हुए)**: controlling or influencing something or someone cleverly or unscrupulously.
